sentence: The programme evaluated six infrastructure policies over more than eighty full runs, with three replication stages culminating in a confirmation under a sealed protocol.

basis.run_count: CONTRIBUTIONS_RUN_COUNT_2026-09-15.json: 82 distinct campaign summary hashes; E0/E1 reused reference counted once; compact horizon limits justify the existing more-than-eighty wording.
basis.three_stages: Section 2.6: incident E2c/E2d, separate morning replication, joint fleet/evaluator-seed confirmation.
